G1.authors: McFadyen, C., Gillan, B., Hartley, R., Robertson, L., Wilks, L., & Hirvonen, A.
G1.title: Serving the Future Policy Briefing: Tackling In-work Poverty in the Hospitality Sector.
kind: 大学研究项目政策简报，不是期刊论文。
University research project policy briefing, not a journal article.
finding: 苏格兰餐旅业研究记录了低薪、不稳定工时，以及额外工作、疲劳、生活费用和托育压力。
Scottish hospitality research records low pay, insecure hours, extra work, fatigue, living costs and childcare pressures.
limits: 研究与苏格兰餐旅业的工作者、雇主及行业相关者合作；不能代表所有英国工作者。
The project worked with workers, employers and industry stakeholders in Scottish hospitality; it does not represent all UK workers.
design: 支持选择餐厅服务作为虚构工作情境，不证明单次工资或缺班惩罚。
Informs the fictional restaurant setting, not the pay per shift or missed-shift penalties.

G2.authors: Wood, A. J., Martindale, N., & Burchell, B. J.
G2.title: Beyond the ‘Gig Economy’: Towards Variable Experiences of Job Quality in Platform Work.
kind: 期刊研究。
Journal research.
finding: 英国平台劳动研究涵盖配送、载客等本地工作，记录了等待和寻找任务所占用的时间。
UK platform-work research includes local delivery and ride-hailing, recording time spent waiting and looking for tasks.
limits: 英国非概率样本 N=510，调查于 2022 年进行，不宜推算全国发生率。本项目未进一步核实等待时间的测量周期，因此不展示时长数值。
A UK non-probability sample of 510, surveyed in 2022; unsuitable for national prevalence estimates. This project has not verified the waiting-time measurement period, so no duration is shown.
design: 可支持“工作投入不一定全部转化为收入”的设计解释，不标定配送工资或体力。
Informs the interpretation that work effort does not always become income; it does not calibrate delivery pay or energy.

G3.authors: Wang, S., Li, L. Z., & Coutts, A.
G3.title: National survey of mental health and life satisfaction of gig workers: The role of loneliness and financial precarity.
kind: 期刊研究。
Journal research.
finding: 该研究的英国零工劳动者子样本中，33.99% 同时有常规工作。
In the study’s UK gig-worker subsample, 33.99% also held a regular job.
limits: 英国疫情期间样本。不能解释为所有贫困家庭的兼职比例，也不能证明兼业全部出于被迫。
A UK pandemic-era sample. This is not the share of all families in poverty with second jobs, nor proof that all dual employment is forced.
design: 启发餐厅与配送并存的虚构情境，不证明游戏角色具有相同经历。
Informs the fictional combination of restaurant and delivery work, not a claim about this character’s real experience.

G4.authors: Giurge, L. M., Whillans, A. V., & West, C.
G4.title: Why time poverty matters for individuals, organisations and nations.
kind: Perspective，综合已有研究。
Perspective synthesising existing research.
finding: 文章讨论时间贫困与幸福感、健康和生活安排的关系。
The article discusses how time poverty relates to wellbeing, health and everyday arrangements.
limits: 不是针对游戏角色的实验，不提供体力恢复公式，也没有直接验证“志愿者浇花”的干预效果。
Not an experiment on this game’s character; it gives no energy-recovery formula and does not directly test volunteer flower watering.
design: 休息、疲劳代价与任务分担是研究启发的设计表达。体力增减不是研究测得的剂量关系。
Rest, fatigue costs and shared tasks are research-inspired design expressions. Energy changes are not measured dose relationships.

G5.authors: Ferragina, E., Tomlinson, M., & Walker, R.
G5.title: Poverty, participation and choice.
kind: 研究报告。
Research report.
finding: 报告研究英国贫困、社会参与与选择之间的关系，讨论资源不足对生活参与的限制。
The report examines poverty, social participation and choice in Britain, including constraints associated with limited resources.
limits: 适合支持社会参与议题，不能用作当前发生率。
Useful for understanding participation; not a current prevalence estimate.
design: 小花象征爱好、关系和照护的空间，是创作隐喻，不是对现实家庭的测量。
The flower symbolises room for hobbies, relationships and care: a creative metaphor, not a measure of real families.

G6.title: Are Poor Parents Poor Parents? The Relationship between Poverty and Parenting among Mothers in the UK.
kind: 期刊研究；2020 年在线发表，2021 年正式刊期。
Journal research; online in 2020, published in the 2021 issue.
finding: 英国母亲的研究提示，只聚焦低收入父母会夸大养育差异，并不恰当地将他们视为问题。
Research on UK mothers cautions that focusing only on low-income parents exaggerates parenting differences and wrongly identifies them as problematic.
limits: 使用英国 Millennium Cohort Study 数据；资源不足不等于关爱不足。
Uses UK Millennium Cohort Study data. Limited resources do not imply limited care or love.
design: 小花不是儿童发展或父母能力的测量工具，不能据此断言低收入父母缺少关爱。
The flower is not a measure of child development or parenting ability; it makes no claim that low-income parents lack love.

G7.authors: Thomson, R. M., Igelström, E., Purba, A. K., Shimonovich, M., Thomson, H., McCartney, G., Reeves, A., Leyland, A., Pearce, A., & Katikireddi, S. V.
G7.title: How do income changes impact on mental health and wellbeing for working-age adults? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
kind: 系统综述与荟萃分析。
Systematic review and meta-analysis.
finding: 综述发现，工作年龄成人的收入变化与心理健康和幸福感变化有关。136 项研究进入叙述性综合，86 项进入荟萃分析。
The review links income changes with mental health and wellbeing in working-age adults: 136 studies in the narrative synthesis and 86 in the meta-analysis.
limits: 136 指研究数量，不是受访者人数。研究差异较大，证据确定性有限。
136 counts studies, not participants. Studies were heterogeneous and evidence certainty was limited.
design: 启发经济支持的叙事，不标定 £120，也不能承诺捐款必然改善所有人的状态。
Informs the financial-support narrative, not the £120 amount or a promise that donations improve everyone’s situation.

G8.title: Employment shocks and financial difficulty: Understanding how leaving paid employment affects ability to meet credit repayments.
kind: 监管机构研究简报。
Regulator research note.
finding: 研究发现失去工作后，信用还款逾期的可能性增加。
The research finds increased likelihood of falling behind on credit payments after job loss.
limits: 关注离开有薪工作与信用还款，不是租房驱逐研究。
Studies leaving paid employment and credit repayments, not rental eviction.
design: 两次缺班辞退、立即求职成功均为游戏规则；研究不支持欠款后立即失去住所。
Dismissal after two missed weeks and immediate job-search success are game rules. The research does not establish immediate loss of housing after arrears.

R1.title: Cambridge City Portrait: State of the City 2023.
kind: 追溯背景材料 · 收入不平等。
Traced background material · income inequality.
finding: 报告支持剑桥具有较高收入不平等，并回顾过往基尼系数排名。
The report supports high income inequality in Cambridge and reviews an earlier Gini-coefficient ranking.
limits: 历史排名基于实验性数据，受学生人口影响；基尼系数最后按城市计算于 2016 年。不是 2026 年最新排名，也未确认就是 brief 的原始脚注。

The historical ranking uses experimental data sensitive to the student population; the city Gini measure was last calculated for 2016. Not a current 2026 ranking or a confirmed original brief footnote.

R2.title: JSNA 2023: Life expectancy and healthy life expectancy.
kind: 追溯背景材料 · 预期寿命不平等。
Traced background material · life-expectancy inequality.
finding: 页面直接支持剑桥最贫困与最不贫困地区男性约 12 年、女性 11.8 年的预期寿命差距。
The page directly reports a Cambridge life-expectancy gap of around 12 years for men and 11.8 years for women between the most and least deprived areas.
limits: 地区人口层面的指标，不能预测某个个人的寿命；不是统一的 2026 年统计快照。未确认就是 brief 原始脚注。
An area-level population indicator, not an individual lifespan prediction or a uniform 2026 snapshot. Not confirmed as the brief’s original footnote.

R3.authors: Social Mobility and Child Poverty Commission.
R3.title: The Social Mobility Index.
R3.venue: Social Mobility and Child Poverty Commission; Cambridge City Council confirmation, 2018, p. 11.
R3.cite: Social Mobility and Child Poverty Commission, 2016
kind: 追溯背景材料 · 青年社会流动性。
Traced background material · youth social mobility.
finding: 市议会 2018 年平等计划第 11 页确认剑桥青年分项倒数第五，并指向 2016 年指数。
Page 11 of the Council’s 2018 equality scheme confirms Cambridge’s fifth-lowest youth score and points to the 2016 index.
limits: 这是青年分项的历史排名，不是总体社会流动性排名或 2026 年排名。未确认就是 brief 原始脚注。
A historical youth-component ranking, not the overall social-mobility ranking or a 2026 ranking. Not confirmed as the brief’s original footnote.

label: 市议会确认材料 · 第 11 页 ↗
Council confirmation · p. 11 ↗

R4.authors: Hutchinson, J., Robinson, D., Carr, D., Hunt, E., Crenna-Jennings, W., & Akhal, A.
R4.title: Education in England: Annual Report 2018.
kind: 待进一步核实 · 原始数值待补核。
Further verification needed · original figure unlocated.
finding: 报告真实，可用于追溯教育差距的背景。
The report exists and is relevant to tracing the education-gap background.
limits: 13.1 个月有同期报道支持，但本项目尚未定位原始详细数据表；不制作已验证数据卡，不宣称已核实 brief 原始脚注。
The 13.1-month figure has contemporaneous reporting, but this project has not located the original detailed table. It is not presented as a verified data card or confirmed original brief footnote.

R5.title: Sufficiency Strategy 2021–2024.
kind: 待进一步核实 · 统计口径有区别。
Further verification needed · different statistical unit.
finding: 报告记录 2019–2020 年约 45% 的安置安排位于郡外。
The report records around 45% of placements outside the county in 2019–2020.
limits: 单位是 placements（安置安排），不能替换为独立儿童人数。尚未完全验证 brief 的“约一半儿童”，也未确认原始脚注。
The unit is placements, not individual children. This does not fully verify the brief’s “around half of children”, nor confirm its original footnote.

R6.title: Housing Key Facts: Homelessness & Rough Sleeping—Summary, Commentary & Data Tables.
kind: 追溯背景材料 · 家庭住房危机与露宿街头。
Traced background material · family housing crisis and rough sleeping.
finding: 2022 年 4 月至 2023 年 3 月，131 户有孩子或孕妇的申请家庭被安置在 B&B 紧急住宿中；上一年度 75 户，增长约 75%。
From April 2022 to March 2023, 131 applicant households with children or a pregnant member were placed in emergency B&B accommodation, up from 75 the previous year: around 75%.
limits: 第 18 页街头清点：2022 年 23 人，上一年 14 人。这是一次清点快照，不是全年全部无家可归人数；不表示游戏中欠款会自动造成无家可归。未确认原始脚注。

Page 18 records 23 rough sleepers in the 2022 count versus 14 a year earlier: a snapshot, not all people homeless during the year. This does not imply automatic homelessness after game arrears. Original footnote unconfirmed.

R7.title: No let-up for millions of families in hardship: JRF’s cost of living tracker, winter 2025.
kind: 补充研究报告 · 英国必需品不足。
Supplementary research report · UK essentials hardship.
finding: 报告称，低收入家庭中 60% 在过去六个月缺少生活必需品，包括食物等。
The report finds that 60% of low-income households had gone without essentials in the preceding six months, including food.
limits: 调查覆盖英国收入最低 40% 的 4,037 个家庭，调查于 2025 年 10–11 月进行。这是英国背景，不是剑桥当地比例。
The survey covered 4,037 UK households in the bottom 40% of incomes in October–November 2025. UK context, not a Cambridge rate.
design: 为食物支持提供背景；每周固定 +2 体力是游戏抽象，不是研究测量或实际服务承诺。
Provides context for food support; +2 energy per week is a game abstraction, not a measured effect or service promise.

text: 餐旅业研究记录了低薪、不稳定工时，以及工作与照护安排之间的冲突。
Hospitality research records low pay, insecure hours and conflicts between work and care.
一项英国研究中，约 34% 的零工劳动者同时有常规工作。
In one UK study, around 34% of gig workers also had a regular job.
时间不足也会影响幸福感、健康和生活安排。
A shortage of time can also affect wellbeing, health and everyday arrangements.
额外工作和人手不足，可能伴随疲劳、压力及工作与生活平衡的恶化。
Extra work and understaffing can bring fatigue, stress and a worsening work–life balance.
design: 本周增加体力、下周扣除体力是表达疲劳代价的游戏设计，不是研究测得的剂量关系。
Adding energy now and deducting it next week expresses fatigue through game design, not a measured dose relationship.

text: 小花代表你想照顾的生活：爱好、关系，以及家庭照护。
The flower represents the life you want to care for: hobbies, relationships and family care.
design: 这是研究启发的创作隐喻。低收入可能限制生活参与和照护资源，但资源不足不等于关爱不足。
A research-inspired creative metaphor. Low income can constrain participation and care resources; limited resources do not mean limited love.

text: 失去收入来源，会让支付压力进一步增加。
Losing a source of income can add to payment pressures.
低收入家庭可能面临食物和生活必需品不足。
Low-income households may face shortages of food and everyday essentials.
收入变化与心理健康、幸福感变化有关。
Income changes are associated with changes in mental health and wellbeing.
分担任务，可以作为释放时间的设计表达。
Sharing tasks is a design expression of making more time available.
design: 该文章没有直接验证“志愿者浇花”的干预效果。
The article does not directly test volunteer flower watering.
